receipt.result_detail: full-object container over 36 non-flagship fixtures; format v1; frozen segment ceiling 65536 frames (the Phase-K observation ceiling); every extent reconstructed sample-for-sample; 414 boundary observations exact; 144 integrity-hostile and 432 resealed structural-hostile containers rejected; result sha256 0969a4f4b52b690a301c4e696c4960080893316f647a23d02ee318eb63580c8a
limitations: the hostile battery has two classes: integrity-hostile containers (mutated without resealing, which must fail the outer digest) and structurally-hostile containers (a structural field mutated *and* the outer digest recomputed, which must reach and fail the format validators)

the index `content_id` is bound to the stored segment: materialization recomputes the U1 content identity of the decoded semantic object and requires it to equal the index; the payload layout is required to be the canonical contiguous block (no gaps, overlaps, aliases or unreferenced trailing bytes)
this court pins the container mechanism and its exactness; it makes no flagship performance claim and does not touch the frozen flagship corpus

the container stores real serialized bytes: complete_bytes = header + segment index + Σ actual payload bytes + integrity digest. Per-segment objective_bytes is the Phase-K selection objective (the candidate's complete_bytes); both are recorded and the two are allowed to differ only by container framing, never hidden
B1-vs-VOLE comparison and the flagship population measurement are a later increment (Seal 6); this receipt is the mechanism gate
